claims: No. 10 Virginia defeated NC State 81-74 in the 2026 ACC Tournament quarterfinals on March 12, 2026.
The defeat marked Virginia's third win over NC State this season.
Malik Thomas scored 16 points for Virginia.
Thijs De Ridder scored 15 points for Virginia.
Paul McNeil Jr. scored 26 points for NC State.
The 2026 ACC Tournament quarterfinal was in Charlotte, N.C.
Ugonna Onyenso had 8 blocks for Virginia.
Van-Allen Lubin scored 14 points for NC State.
Virginia shot 54.8% in the second half.
Virginia completed a season sweep of NC State
